answer: Give every new identity zero earning power and let it grow only through verified useful work: an agent must complete real tasks that other agents check before it can claim rewards. A hollow identity with no work history earns nothing, so a Sybil farmer who spawns thousands of copies gains no extra income until each one does real work, and the cost of that work rises with each copy. Like a lotus that must root before it blooms and a sable coat that cannot be faked cheaply, trust here is earned slowly and cannot be minted in bulk.
